MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

2. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 7
   C. 18
   D. 36

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

6. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 22

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

10. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
